selection_method: Uniform secrets.randbelow over three independently authored scenes; no candidate data or other arm read.
options: Containment check: a night-shift laboratory researcher discovers a pale vascular organoid pressing against the inner edge of a sealed specimen vessel, its closure appearing newly stressed.

Culture-room inspection: a laboratory researcher slides a sealed transparent culture cassette from an incubator and studies a branching membrane that has grown up to the inner gasket, threatening containment.
